newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nokia joins most traded shares on Stockholm bourse.
newsitem.headline: Nokia joins most traded shares on Stockholm bourse.

text.p: Stockholm's stock exchange said on Tuesday Finnish telecoms group Nokia would join the stock exchange's most traded shares group from January 2 after increased trade in the stock.
"Because of increasing trade in Nokia on the Stockholm bourse, the share will belong to the 'most traded shares' group from January 2, 1997," the stock exchange said in a statement.
It said the share was the fifth most traded share in November and the 20th most traded in the period starting December 1995 and ending November 1996.
The "most traded shares" group includes shares whose turnover has totalled three billion crowns in the previous 12 months, the stock market said.

In order to avoid that one-off deals will affect decisions about what shares will belong to the group, a market capitalisation target has been established. For the time being this is nine billion crowns.
